panels.headline: Try Omarchy grows up
paragraphs: Try Omarchy 1.0 uses the official Omarchy M image and ARM package mirror. Updates now happen inside the guest, with an import path for files from your previous VM.
It’s still a VM running the development channel. The 1.0.1 patch disables nested virtualisation by default on M3+ Macs.

panels.headline: Let the video chip do the video
panels.sourceHeadline: Let the video chip do the video
paragraphs: A Snapdragon change enables hardware video decoding in mpv and Chromium.
The contributor reports roughly a fifth of the CPU use for 1080p playback in mpv on a Yoga Slim 7x. Software fallback remains.
Useful progress, not a stable-release claim or a promise for every ARM laptop.

panels.headline: Copy on iPhone, paste on Omarchy
panels.sourceHeadline: Copy on iPhone, paste on Omarchy
paragraphs: Unayung’s iPhone Clipboard connects your phone and computer over Tailscale. iOS Back Tap sends or fetches the clipboard.
Setup includes the service and shortcuts. Anyone with the token and access over your tailnet can read and replace your clipboard.
One less reason to message yourself a URL.

panels.headline: My skills needed fewer words
paragraphs: I cut the plugin skill entry points by 58% and the theme instructions by about 28%. Detailed mechanics stay in linked references.
Community feedback now informs more deliberate application colours. Personal tweaks can stay personal.
